liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Jack Straw** (1 review): Opener played crisply and ripping, a first-set highlight [4]
- **Cassidy** (1 review): Reviewer found Cassidy nice, with the drummers sounding strong [12]
- **Sugaree** (1 review): Short but explosive version, singled out as a first-set highlight [4]
- **He's Gone** (1 review): The acapella section is fantastic; it then dissolves into a short Drums, where Phil takes a solo [13]
- **The Other One** (1 review): Reviewer says it contains a great jam [14]
- **Around and Around** (1 review): Reviewer thinks it may be the best version they have heard [8]
- Reviewer counts it among their absolute favorites and finds it uplifting [5]

## Setlist highlights

- **SSDD**: back after 307 archived shows (1977 days); rare: 5 archived performances [16]

## The recordings

- **gd1978-02-01.138451.sbd.GEMS.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 19 songs; 139 min; rated 3.75/5 by 4 [1]
- **gd78-02-01.sbd.parillo.1017.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 17 songs; 133 min; rated 4.36/5 by 25 [3]. Said about its sound: Described as a crisp soundboard recording of an undercirculated show; Calls this recording perfect, with a delightful mix of the songs; Sound quality described as superb [4][5][6][9][10][12][13]
- **gd1978-02-01.aud.cousinit.97744.sbefail.flac16**: audience recording; 19 songs; 141 min; rated 4.57/5 by 7 [2]

## Around the show

- Attendee of all the Uptown shows rates the 1/31 show as the best of the three [11]
- Garcia is on here, but not as strong as in the 2-3 and 2-5 shows [13]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1978-02-01.138451.sbd.GEMS.flac16**: transferred by Speed Correction and Patching by Jason Chastain,mastering by Jamie Waddell; source: SBD Master Reel > Cassette > DAT; 16 bit 44.1kHz FLAC Level8 SBE Free; Speed Correction and Patching by Jason Chastain in Audition CC; Mastering by Jamie… [1]
- **gd78-02-01.sbd.parillo.1017.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [3]. Also: Reviewer's college-era tape was copied so many times that Garcia sounded like a chipmunk; this transfer is much better [5]
- **gd1978-02-01.aud.cousinit.97744.sbefail.flac16**: transferred by Cousinit; source: MAC>R>C [2]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Dave's Picks Vol. 57: Uptown Theatre, Chicago, IL 2/1/78](https://store.dead.net/products/8a1875c4dfcb93dbd73) [17]
